import json, sys, pathlib, pytest
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_info
from scripts import r8_e01_material_frame_work as work
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); repo = root.parents[2]
code = pytest.main(['-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'development_test_runtime', '--basetemp', str(root/'pytest-temp-v2'), '--junitxml='+str(root/'junit-v2.xml'), str(repo/'tests/test_r8_e01_material_frame_work.py')])
if code: sys.exit(code)
args = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
record = work.main(args)
pools = threadpool_info()
assert all(p['num_threads'] == 1 for p in pools), pools
(root/'diagnostic-runtime-v2.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(effective_pools=pools, imported_map=work.__file__, source_sha256=record['source_sha256'], qualified=False), indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(captures=len(record['captures']), samples=[len(c['diagnostic']['samples']) for c in record['captures']], qualified=False, effective_pool_threads=[p['num_threads'] for p in pools])))
